body:
Part of #4023. The delivery plan of the path kernel changed on 2026-11-27 (comment on #4023: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/4023#issuecomment-7215353049). The docs must agree with it.

## The maintainer's words

"well then we should preemptive bring it up to main, and merge it without implementing a switch over, making sure it doesnt break and then start switching over.." (2026-11-27). His answers in the question dialog of the same day: the operations switch one at a time, each in its own PR on `main`; the first merge into `main` does not wait for 2D Pocket; the coordinator session merges the one PR from `side/path-kernel` to `main` when an independent review is clean and the gates are green.

## What to do

1. Add a decision record `docs/decisions/<this issue>-path-kernel-delivery.md` (format: `docs/decisions/README.md`). It replaces these parts of the K0 record (#4024, now in `RECOMMENDED.md`): "replace in one go", "one switch for all 16 kinds", "the switch-over PR" and "the removal PR". New text: the kernel merges to `main` with the default at the old planner; each kind switches in its own PR on `main`; the old planner of a kind is removed after its switch; the conditions #4260, #4272, #4300 and #4236 hold for the switch of each kind that they touch. Do not edit `RECOMMENDED.md` (the cut gathers it).
2. Change the rule **Side branch** in `AGENTS.md` only where it does not agree:
   - the pointer to `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md` (the file is in `RECOMMENDED.md` since the v0.27.0 cut): point to the heading in `RECOMMENDED.md` and to the new record;
   - "The switch-over is one PR ... It lists `Fixes #N` for each issue that it closes": the PR from the side branch to `main` uses `Refs`, and an issue closes with the switch PR of its kind or with its own work;
   - who merges that PR (the maintainer's answer of 2026-11-27).
   Keep the stable name of the rule. Change no other rule.
3. Check the skills `work-issue` and `merge-ready` for a line that the change makes wrong; fix only such a line.

## Done means

The record and the rule agree with the plan of 2026-11-27. The PR body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
